parts.label: Exposition
parts.text: Yusuf finds an old key in his late grandfather's coat. | Tension: no door in the house fits it. | Crisis: in the shed, a locked box. | Climax: the lid lifts slowly: letters, decades old. | Resolution: he understands his grandfather's quiet kindness, and keeps writing to the people in the letters.
